findingDetails.title: The drift guard discards out_of_order_anchor, so a reordered example passes
findingDetails.evidence: The guard greps only ^(missing_anchor|extra_anchor) for both printing and status; template-structure.js:921 also emits out_of_order_anchor, which no consumer in the skill reads.
findingDetails.recommendation: Include out_of_order_anchor in the guarded pattern set, or delete the emitter and state that anchor order is unconstrained.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Guard lines 35 and 39 read directly; an rg over the skill returns only the two emitters and no reader.

findingDetails.title: check-card-sync.sh asks jq -e a per-mode question and reads only the last answer
findingDetails.evidence: jq -e sets exit status from the last output of .modes[].leaves | index($p) != null; with one mode the defect is latent, with two it can pass while a mode omits the card.
findingDetails.recommendation: Aggregate with [.modes[].leaves | index($p) != null] | all and assert the array is non-empty.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Guard line 98 read directly; jq .modes | keys prints [0], so the manifest holds one mode today.

findingDetails.title: The drift guard reports success when rg is not installed
findingDetails.evidence: set -uo pipefail without -e and no command -v check; a 127 from the status test leaves status 0 and flow reaches echo EXAMPLE_DRIFT_OK.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add a command -v rg guard that exits non-zero with a named reason.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Guard lines 5, 35, 39 and 43 read directly; the failure path follows from set -uo pipefail and the && status test.

findingDetails.title: The checklist check proves only that the old sentence is gone
findingDetails.evidence: Check 5 is a negative grep for the retired sentence; deleting the checklist example pointer at spec-folder-authoring-checklist.md:36 still yields PASS checklist.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add a positive assertion that the checklist names templates/examples/ or the card before the negative one.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Guard lines 109-114 read directly; the pointer exists once at checklist line 36 and is not asserted.
